metadata.title: Johnson optimality and uniqueness for distance ratio $1:\sqrt{2}$
metadata.abstract: We prove that a two-distance set in $\mathbb R^d$ with distance ratio $1:\sqrt{2}$ has at most $d(d+1)/2$ points for every $d\ge9$. Equality in full affine dimension characterizes the Johnson construction; for $d\ge10$, the full-dimensional condition is automatic. The proof separates configurations according to the connectivity of the short-distance graph. The connected case uses root lattices and intersection theorems, while the disconnected case uses an orthogonal decomposition into component direction spaces and the span of their center differences. We also prove a relative bound for Euclidean two-distance sets and show that equality forces sphericity. Together with the Larman--Rogers--Seidel theorem, these results give maximum cardinality $d(d+1)/2$ for $9\le d\le21$ and $275$ for $d=22$, without exhaustive enumeration.

analysis.progressType: 两距离集的最优基数与唯一性
analysis.workSummary: 对 Rᵈ 中距离比1:√2的两距离集，证明 d≥9 时至多 d(d+1)/2 点；满仿射维等号刻画 Johnson 构造，d≥10 时满维条件自动满足。结合相对界及 Larman–Rogers–Seidel 定理，得到一般 Euclid 两距离集在9≤d≤21的最大基数 d(d+1)/2、d=22 时为275。
techniques: 短距离图的连通/非连通分解
分量方向空间及中心差空间的正交分解
analysis.breakthrough: 不借穷举得到一段维数范围的最优基数，并刻画指定距离比的等号结构；相对界等号强制球面性。
analysis.limitations: d=9 的 Johnson 唯一性仍须满仿射维，不能与 d≥10 的自动条件混淆；一般两距离集与固定比值定理是不同层次。 当前数学解读依据摘要，尚未逐步审读证明。
